# Hamza Ali Basra

> Hamza Ali Basra (born 1 November 1998) is a Pakistani entrepreneur based in Los Angeles, USA. Founder of Grab AI Tool (an AI tools directory) and ToolPixi (free browser-based online tools). He also publishes Daily Insights: short essays on entrepreneurship and building an audience honestly.

## Who he is

- Name: Hamza Ali Basra
- Born: 1 November 1998
- Based: Los Angeles, California, USA
- Role: Entrepreneur, founder of Grab AI Tool and ToolPixi
- Media contact: hamzaalibasra786@gmail.com

## Ventures and profiles

- [Grab AI Tool](https://grabaitool.github.io/): AI tools directory — tests, reviews, comparisons, tool-finder quiz and cost calculator.
- [ToolPixi](https://toolpixi.github.io/): Free online tools that run entirely in your browser.
